adaptation: Native sign adapter reuses road geometry and editing. elements.js delegates paintRoad to DiagrammaticRoadRenderer, calls diagrammaticRender after drawing, adds stem ordering commands, and filters unrelated context-menu actions. Diagrammatics.js adapts sheets.js pointer-anchored zoom, wheel device detection, Safari gestures, and drag/pinch panning to the sign viewport. The Add command map includes a native Place subpanel action; the adapter routes editing keys and counter-scales handle UI for whole-preview zoom. Diagrammatic-only attached-arc constraints preserve the host tangent and connected mouth when radius, sweep, or free-end position changes. New diagrammatic drawing points snap to eight compass directions; off-axis connection targets cannot override the angular constraint.
